title: Taste Canada: Non-Touristy St Lawrence Market Food Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Canada’s most iconic flavors on a non-touristy guided tasting tour through St. Lawrence Market - named the world’s best food market by National Geographic. Taste a curated lineup of Canadian and Toronto-born specialties, from peameal bacon sandwiches to butter tarts, while hearing the stories behind the vendors who made them famous. With VIP skip-the-line access, enjoy priority tastings at some of the market’s most sought-after vendors. With over 15 years of experience, join Toronto’s original food tour company - the locally owned food tour that Toronto natives bring their friends on.

• Enjoy a guided exploration of St. Lawrence Market with locally loved tastings that add up to a full meal
• Learn about the history and culture of Canadian and Torontonian cuisine
• Toronto’s smallest food tour groups for a more personal experience (up to 12 on weekdays, 6 on busy weekends) 
• The most accommodating Toronto food tour for dietary restrictions - vegetarian, vegan and more
